key.name: stage
key.description: The 3-stage intervention slider mirror: "A" (full-auto), "B" (onsite + semi-auto), or "C" (onsite-manual). The authoritative copy lives on the org.gnome.Phantom D-Bus service; this key mirrors it for the UI. Written by exactly one writer (PhantomService.writeStageMirror, driven from ModeController.applyProfile). See docs/PHANTGNOME-ARCHITECTURE.md section 2 and docs/MODES.md.

key.name: default-stage
key.description:
The stage applied at session start before the human picks one from the non-grabbing boot chooser. Per MODES.md the chooser must never block inject, so an unattended/headless boot falls to this configured default. One of "A", "B", "C".
DEFAULT CHANGED "B" -> "C" (Owner 2026-08-07). The documentation sells "cold-by-default; opt-in act/sense" and stage B as "ask-first" — but modeController.js defines B as gate 'on', full access, proactive, with confirmAffordance false. An unattended boot therefore came up WARM with full access and no confirmation, which is the opposite of the promise. "C" (onsite-manual) is the cold one. If a warm default is ever wanted again it must be a deliberate, documented choice — not the shipping state that quietly contradicts the sales copy.

key.name: llm-window-match
key.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against a window's wm_class / wm_class_instance / title to identify the ON-SCREEN LLM surface — the focal tile of full-auto ("Voll-Auto = nur LLM-Fenster sonst nichts"). In Mode A the ModeController KEEPS this window visible (opacity 255, centered + raised) while demoting every other app to opacity 0, so the seat shows only the LLM window plus the HUD. The default matches the phantom autostart terminal launched with --app-id=phantom-llm (foot) or whose title is set to phantom-llm. Empty string disables the focal carve- out (Mode A then blanks ALL apps, the prior behavior). Changing this key live re-sorts the desktop immediately if Mode A is active.

key.name: summon-llm
key.summary: Bring the LLM (claude) window to the front
key.description: Global shortcut summoning the phantom LLM (claude) window to the foreground from any mode.
